title: Shifts in embryonic oxygen levels cue heterochrony in limb initiation.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Read the data availability statement on PMC (PMC13636768). Pulled GEO metadata: GSE298623 (bulk RNA-seq, 24 GSM samples, 3 count files) and GSE298624 (single-cell RNA-seq, 3 GSM samples, one 2.2 GB Seurat .rds, not downloaded). Opened GSE298623_raw_reads_count_chick.txt.gz: 24,356 chicken Ensembl genes x 16 columns. The columns are named after mouse E8.5 BAM files and split by read mate (R1/R2), so this file holds about 8 biological samples.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: The experimental design: chick HH12 and mouse E8.5/E9.5 forelimb vs hindlimb tissue, and mouse embryos cultured outside the uterus in low (hypoxia) vs normal oxygen for the single-cell data. Images are on figshare; other raw data is only 'available upon request'.

a1_downloadable.note: Both GEO series are public with no login. The single-cell Seurat object is 2.2 GB (HEAD only).

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Checked in the files: there's no outcome table. The only labels are experimental conditions (forelimb vs hindlimb, species, low vs normal oxygen), and they live in sample names or metadata, not in a measured outcome column.

a3_inputs_present.note: The count matrices use Ensembl gene IDs (checked in the chick file).

a4_units_stated.note: Raw read counts (checked in the file).

a5_enough_rows.note: Bulk: 24 GEO samples in total, and the chick file has about 8 biological samples (16 read-mate columns). Single-cell: 3 samples, so any oxygen-condition label is pseudoreplicated across cells from 3 embryos pools.

a6_fits_laptop.note: The bulk data is tiny. The single-cell data is too, after subsetting.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: The file named 'chick' has chicken gene IDs but mouse E8.5 column names. That's a labelling inconsistency.

a8_label_provenance.note: The conditions were set by the experiment design, not predicted by a model.

honest_claim_h3: With about 8 to 24 bulk samples and 3 single-cell samples, no model trained here could support more than a differential-expression description.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use gene expression in early limb tissue to predict whether an embryo grew under low or normal oxygen.
plain_idea.train_on: Bulk gene counts from forelimb and hindlimb regions (24 GEO samples), or single cells from 3 cultured mouse embryo samples.
plain_idea.predict: The oxygen condition or limb identity, which the experimenters set by design.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: It could produce an oxygen-response expression signature for development, but the sample counts are far too small to learn one.

ml_idea: Classify hypoxia vs normoxia or forelimb vs hindlimb from expression. This isn't viable: there are too few independent samples, and no measured outcome.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated, because the project is rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count the biological samples in GSE298623. Done: 24 GEO samples, and about 8 in the chick file.

verdict_reason: This is a mechanistic developmental-biology paper with 24 bulk RNA-seq samples (genome-wide gene expression measurements from tissue) and 3 single-cell samples. Its only labels are experimental conditions, and one count file has mismatched labels.
